tagline: A living olive landscape leads into a personal introduction and an interactive first-session guide.
rationale: The original olive landscape opens the page. Animated illustrations pair a notebook, two chairs and a window with worry, connection and change. The first-session room stays still while labelled markers highlight each stage and show a sample question.
name: The Listening Garden
typography: Locally bundled Manrope and Instrument Serif in roman and italic; word-by-word scroll reveals, oversized editorial headings and a velocity-responsive type ribbon.
homepage: Refined landscape, drifting mist and responsive leaves
Illustrated conversation starters and example opening words
Interactive steps from inquiry to decision
Filtered practical questions and copyable email starters
mobile: Stacked personal interview and room guide, large numbered controls and no horizontal overflow at 390px. Selecting a room marker on a narrow screen brings its explanation into view.
supporting: The new room is explicitly conceptual, not a photograph of the actual office. Draft personal statements and process examples require approval. Email starters are copied locally and never submitted by this website.
trust: A prominent authentic portrait and approved personal details should be supplied before publication.
seo: Keep name, verified designation, services and Vancouver location in visible text. Use descriptive page titles in production.
accessibility: Global pause and reduced-motion preference support; native touch and keyboard scrolling; visible focus; ordinary headings and links; selected states for interaction controls. Final production accessibility testing is still required.
tradeoff: The original 1536×1024 artwork is used again. Actual portrait, credentials and approved practice details are required.
